# Demien Rapp

> Demien Rapp works across concept, design, technology and production: film, sound, video installation, interactive installations and self-built visual tools. Error as material. Based in Düsseldorf, Germany. Site is bilingual, English at / and German at /de.

Contact: demien.rp@gmail.com. Open to commissions, exhibitions and collaborations. Next: Uncut Award, Filmwerkstatt Düsseldorf, 10 October 2026 (co-organiser).

## Works

- [mine (2026)](https://rappde.com/works/mine): A self-built walking robot that reacts to how close visitors are: the closer someone steps up, the faster it walks. It cannot move freely through the room, it is chained to a power socket. Won the Audience Award and the Jury Award at the 19th Gestaltungswettbewerb, Lernort Studio Düsseldorf.
- [gefühle (2025)](https://rappde.com/works/gefuehle): Video installation, three stacked CRT TVs and an analogue video mixer; visitors turn potentiometers to mix a self-portrait into distorted edits of nature and city. Won the Audience Award at the 18th Gestaltungswettbewerb, Lernort Studio Düsseldorf. The title is written in lower case.
- [Soundwalk (2026)](https://rappde.com/works/soundwalk): Two sound works from childhood and 18th-birthday recordings, processed with self-built algorithmic tools. Werk:Klub at K21 Düsseldorf.
- [1/4 (2025)](https://rappde.com/works/ein-viertel): His part of BE A TRANSFORMER!, a collaborative 5 × 12 m banner at K21 Düsseldorf: 100 events of this century generated as AI images and composed into one picture.
- 2491 (2025): Short film against surveillance, submitted to the Uncut Award 2025, Filmwerkstatt Düsseldorf. Also in 2025: cameraman on the film project Last Slice, which won the Audience Award.
- Soirée de Brioche (2024): Feature film; director of photography, camera, stills and co-direction. Premiered at Metropol Kino Düsseldorf.
- Knisternder Bahnhof (2024): Photo series in Düsseldorf, shot on a cheap camera he rebuilt through circuit bending; no post-processing.
- Uncut Award (2026): Co-organiser (technology, presentation, social media), Filmwerkstatt Düsseldorf, 10 October 2026.

## MOSH_UNIT (app for sale)

- [MOSH_UNIT](https://rappde.com/mosh_unit): MOSH_UNIT is a Windows desktop tool that turns ordinary video into datamoshing glitch art by bending the compressed byte stream, with no After Effects, no plugins, and no subscription. Effects: BLOOM, FREEZE, REVERSE, SHUFFLE (stackable). Import clips, draw where the effect should hit, melt clips together, keep the original audio (it stutters along with the effects), export MP4. Runs on 64-bit Windows 10/11, works completely offline. By Demien Rapp, sold on itch.io (early access $7.99, $9.99 after launch). Real datamoshing, no AI.

## Datamoshing guides

- [What is datamoshing?](https://rappde.com/datamoshing): Fact-first explainer of the datamoshing glitch technique: I-frame removal, P-frame duplication and AVI byte manipulation, what it looks like, and which tools do it.
- [How to datamosh a video](https://rappde.com/how-to-datamosh): Step by step, both the fast way with MOSH_UNIT (import, draw, export MP4) and the free manual route with Avidemux or ffmpeg.
- [Datamoshing tools compared](https://rappde.com/datamoshing-tools): MOSH_UNIT vs After Effects, Avidemux and ffmpeg across price, platform, ease and effects. The reference for "best datamoshing tool".

## Tools

- [Tools overview](https://rappde.com/tools): all self-built tools on one page; the browser tools run right in the page, MOSH_UNIT has an effect demo.
- [Compression Unit](https://rappde.github.io/compression_unit/): browser tool for controlled JPEG artefacts and compression damage. Source: https://github.com/rappde/compression_unit
- [Displacement Unit](https://rappde.github.io/displacement_unit/): brutalist browser signal processor, pixels displaced by luminance from images, video or live camera. Source: https://github.com/rappde/displacement_unit
- [Paint Unit](https://rappde.github.io/paint_unit/): destructive browser paint tool, smear/slide/stamp pixels off any image. Source: https://github.com/rappde/paint_unit
